name: Korea Asset In Trust Co., Ltd.
summary: Korea Asset In Trust Co., Ltd. operates as a specialized real estate trust firm based in South Korea, providing a comprehensive range of property-related services. Its core offerings include trust solutions for land development, property management, asset disposition, collateral arrangements, and sales oversight. The company also furnishes expert real estate consulting and agency services, alongside trust maintenance and tax advisory support. Furthermore, it engages in financial services suchulating asset-backed and mortgage bonds, bond-secured securities, and facilitating real estate investment and project financing. Founded in 2001, Korea Asset In Trust Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
